items.text: ETR/Levitan projecting Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT in projections despite GTD status; team 'not counting on him playing.' Keep late DFS swap open for Bateman/Andrews. Workout later reported looking good but decision pending.
items.why: Team sources indicate not counting on him; hamstring; limited practice history.
items.implication: Downgrade Flowers; elevate Ravens other pass-catchers in DFS/season-long if confirmed out or limited.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Bateman and Mark Andrews if Flowers inactive or pitch-counted.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder, Q) expected to play and confirmed active vs Bengals. ETR listed expected to play.
items.why: Schefter expected then actives list; ETR expected.
items.implication: Full or near-full role expected; start confidently.
items.opportunity: Maintains carries/snaps; Dowdle out boosts further.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (finger, Q/GTD) expected inactive vs Lions. Levitan lists Jets WR depth: Garrett Wilson, Isaiah Williams, Jamaal Pritchett, Sterling Shepard, Malik McLain; TE Kenyon Sadiq expected slot/wide work. Mitchell had team-high 12 targets prior week.
items.why: Source per Fowler; confirmed in Schefter/Rapoport inactives.
items.implication: Wilson primary; deeper Jets WRs/TE see expanded routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Route/target bump for Wilson and remaining Jets pass-catchers.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected to play vs Chargers and later confirmed active. ETR projecting in but limited.
items.why: Source: expected to play; Schefter actives list includes him.
items.implication: Startable but monitor for limitation; volume may be capped early.
items.opportunity: Maintains WR role; if limited, secondary Bills WRs (Coleman active) gain.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee, Q) expected to play per ETR weekend summary; Levitan projecting IN despite Q tag.
items.implication: TE1 usage likely intact; start with confidence.

items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith expected to play (ETR); earlier off injury report and good to go for MNF per Schefter/Rapoport.
items.why: ETR list; official off report good to go.
items.implication: Full workloads expected Monday; lock into lineups.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring: doctors 3-4 week injury timeline (Schefter/Rapoport). Out Week 3; quick healer hoping to beat it. Bagent Q.
items.implication: Bears QB carousel; stash or drop depending league size; Bagent streamer candidate.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Bears skill players short-term under backup; ROS Williams delayed.

items.text: Puka Nacua doubtful for SNF at DEN (mainly groin impacting explosiveness); functionally can play but not at prior explosiveness. Short-term; possible next week vs PHI; surgery not expected.
items.why: Groin; sources on nature and timeline.
items.implication: Likely sit Week 3; hold for near-term return.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight week (hamstring); 'decent chance' return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% target share last week with Collins out; Colts allow TE yards.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot, Q) expected to play vs Bengals. ETR expected to play.
items.implication: Likely active and productive; low risk sit.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (hip, Q) plans to play vs Arizona; ETR expected to play. Good to go.
items.why: Source plans to play; ETR/Levitan projecting IN.
items.implication: Start Evans; full or near role likely.

items.text: Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D; prop support.
items.opportunity: High carry/volume ceiling in favorable game script.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit targets, high aDOT, LV allows league-high YPR to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% TS with Collins out; IND 4th-most TE yards allowed).
items.why: Volume + matchup edges; Schultz usage spike confirmed.
items.implication: Strong WR/TE starts; Schultz streaming/priority with Collins out.
items.opportunity: Olave air-yards dominance; Schultz elevated target share.

items.text: Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs) and Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% RB touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there).
items.opportunity: Henderson saw 65% snaps/out-touched post-Stevenson fumble (Berry fact); monitor split.

items.text: Berry loves Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ targets, WR9 PPG since last yr Wk11). Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FPs to WRs allowed; low implied total; tough YPR).
items.why: Watson usage/efficiency; McLaurin tough matchup + QB uncertainty.
items.implication: Start Watson; fade/sit McLaurin this week.

items.text: After Stevenson fumble Week 2, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield 65% snap rate and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3.
items.implication: Henderson rising handcuff/committee value; monitor for lead role flip.
items.opportunity: Elevated early-down and overall share potential.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Stevenson short-term due to pass pro.
